# Security Checklist: User Authentication System

**Purpose**: Validate security requirement quality, completeness, and clarity for authentication flows before implementation planning.
**Created**: 2026-05-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are credential storage requirements explicitly specified (for example hash algorithm, salting, and secret handling) rather than implied? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are JWT claim requirements (issuer, audience, subject, issued-at, expiry, session identifier) fully defined for all issued tokens? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-006a]
- [ ] CHK003 Are reset token generation requirements defined with minimum entropy/unguessability criteria? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for revocation scope after password reset (all devices/sessions vs scoped revocation)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is "continued abuse increases lock duration" quantified with explicit escalation steps and maximum lock window? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004a]
- [ ] CHK006 Is "clear, non-sensitive error message" defined with concrete do/don't response rules to prevent leakage? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "generic reset-request success response" clearly constrained so it remains consistent for existing and non-existing accounts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007a]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "operational monitoring" defined with measurable logging fields and alert thresholds? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-012a]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Do lockout requirements align across user stories, edge cases, and functional requirements without conflicting thresholds? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-004a]
- [ ] CHK010 Do session-expiry requirements remain consistent between 24-hour absolute expiry and server-side revocation checks? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-010a]
- [ ] CHK011 Do password-policy requirements match between validation requirements and reset scenarios without weaker exceptions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-002a, Spec §User Story 2]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK012 Do acceptance scenarios include objective pass/fail criteria for lockout, reset-token expiry, and session revocation timing boundaries? [Measurability, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing]
- [ ] CHK013 Are success metrics linked to security outcomes (for example enumeration resistance, unauthorized access rejection rates) rather than only usability outcomes? [Gap, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK014 Can SC-004 be verified objectively with a defined tolerance for clock skew and token validation timing? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements present for alternate authentication scenarios such as login from a new device with existing active sessions? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK016 Are exception-flow requirements defined for email provider outage beyond three retries (for example terminal failure behavior and user messaging)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007b, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Are recovery-flow requirements specified for users locked out by progressive abuse controls (for example unlock conditions and retry reset)? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-004a]
- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements specified for concurrent events (password reset during active API calls) and expected consistency behavior? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-009]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are duplicate-registration requirements explicit about race conditions and near-simultaneous submissions? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK020 Are near-expiry reset-token and JWT boundary behaviors defined for client/server time skew? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Are retry-queue security requirements documented for replay, duplicate send suppression, and idempotency? [Gap, Spec §FR-007b]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK022 Are security logging requirements specific about retention, access control, and tamper-evidence for authentication events? [Non-Functional, Gap, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-012a]
- [ ] CHK023 Are privacy and data-minimization requirements defined for auth logs and reset events to avoid sensitive data exposure? [Non-Functional, Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 Are availability requirements defined for auth operations during dependency degradation (email provider delays/outages)? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-007b, Spec §Assumptions]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK025 Is dependence on a single email delivery capability accompanied by explicit fallback or degradation requirements? [Dependency, Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK026 Are trust boundaries and assumptions for external components (email provider, token signing secrets, clock source) documented as requirements? [Assumption, Gap]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK027 Is there any conflict between "generic success responses" and supportability expectations for user guidance and troubleshooting? [Conflict Check, Spec §FR-007a, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK028 Are undefined terms ("abuse", "non-sensitive", "operational monitoring") replaced by measurable definitions? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004a, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-012a]

## Notes

- Checklist focus: security review for auth requirements with broader ecosystem security considerations.
- Intended use: peer reviewer checklist during PR/spec review at standard rigor.
